cues: Hess's law also lets us find the lattice enthalpy of an ionic solid, which can never be measured directly.
This is the Born Haber cycle for sodium chloride.
Start from sodium metal and chlorine gas.
Turn sodium into a gas: plus one oh eight.
Break half a mole of chlorine bonds: half of two forty two, plus one twenty one.
